prompts.desktop:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high fidelity static bitmap design for the original personal fitness tracker FORM. Input image1 is the approved mobile CONCEPT STYLE ANCHOR: preserve wordmark, typography, graphite palette, violet weekly checkmarks, restrained white pill controls, photographic identity and coach Maya Chen. Adapt to the requested surface rather than drawing a phone. All displayed concepts are fictional and not official Peloton interfaces. Original fitness tracker named FORM, informed by a visual study of current Peloton App, Strength+, Bike+, Row, Tread and Peloton IQ. Matte graphite #15171B and near-black #0B0C0F, off-white type, subtle charcoal divisions, gentle 14px corners. Contemporary readable neo-grotesk typography, medium weight, sentence case, tabular metrics. Normal width typography, no condensed display fonts. Photography is the hero: richly detailed editorial real human movement, premium dark studio with soft light, natural skin, calm confidence, no dystopian neon. White pill primary controls. Purple #8068EF is reserved for completed days and progress; small peach accents for time. Accent colors are functional, not glowing. Cohesive open sections and an uninterrupted weekly rhythm rather than a wall of dashboard cards. No banking ledger aesthetic, no white dashboard, no neon-green recovery dial, no circular score as centerpiece, no chrome/gloss/3D bevels, no generic SaaS gradient blobs. Icons are small consistent line icons. All text crisp and readable with deliberate padding. This is an original concept, not a fake official Peloton screenshot; use FORM wordmark, no Peloton logo or real instructor identity. Fictional date Sunday Oct 25, 2026, selected week Oct 19–25. Completed: Mon19 45min Ride, Wed21 35min Strength, Sat24 60min Run. Total 140min, 3active days,3of4 weekly workouts complete. Tue20,Thu22,Fri23 Rest. Sun25 has planned 20min Mobility, still not completed and not included in totals. Violet completed checkmarks only Mon19/Wed21/Sat24; Sunday an outlined selection. Coach Maya Chen is fictional. Latest run 60min,7.2km,8:20/km,avgHR134bpm.

A restrained graphite desktop titlebar with tiny macOS traffic lights, title FORM. Left 180px slim sidebar with FORM, 'Today' selected, 'Your plan', 'Progress', 'History', then subdued 'Library' and 'Settings', account Alex at bottom.

Integrated seven-day rail across content, Mon19, Tue20, Wed21, Thu22, Fri23, Sat24, Sun25, exactly three violet completed checks Mon/Wed/Sat and outlined selectedSun. Under rail a spacious unboxed stats strip '3/4 Workouts' '140 min' '3 Active days', fine violet75%goal line.
Largest composition below: cinematic photograph of fictional female coach Maya Chen doing mobility lunge in a premium lavender-grey studio, taking the right55% of central area; left45% dark continuous editorial surface. Small 'TODAY · RECOVERY', headline 'A little space to reset.', supporting '20 min Mobility', 'Maya Chen · All levels', whitepill 'Start session', a subdued 'View session' textlink. Avoid every area boxed. Below a beautifully aligned single 'Recent activity' section with three compact horizontal rows and small photographic thumbnails: '60 min Outdoor Run' 'Sat, Oct 24 · Easy'; '35 min Full Body Strength' 'Wed, Oct 21 · Moderate'; '45 min Ride' 'Mon, Oct 19 · Moderate'.
